prep.notes: Extracted village centroids from '臺北市里界圖' and converted TWD97 TM2 coordinates to WGS84. Aggregated population from '臺北市各里人口數按年齡分...' to the latest period, total gender, and village level. Joined on District and Village name using prep.match. Used CPTVID as unique village ID. Kept all 456 villages in Taipei.
